subject: Error: the leading minor of order 2 is not positive definite

messages.author: 72f3d26fe9bf3a61
messages.subject: Error: the leading minor of order 2 is not positive definite
parts:
Hi all,

Hope your week is going well. 

I encountered an error message when building the model: 

Error in chol.default(model$taub[model$L[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(INDEXEDNODEINFO_,  : the leading minor of order 2 is not positive definite

I do not know what this message means. Please see my code and data attached. Thank you very much for your help in advance.


Best,
Chris

messages.author: 7878556d408ec9ec
messages.subject: Re: Error: the leading minor of order 2 is not positive definite
parts:
Hi Chris,

I think your problem is due to the fact that the one of the taub matrices you provide to the model is not positive definite. From the way you generated the initial values for taub matrices, they cannot be guaranteed to be symmetric, which is required as a positive definite matrix. The support of the Wishart distribution consists of positive definite matrices. The non-pos-def matrix is then provided to the mv normal as a precision matrix, which is not valid. Then doing cholesky decomposition gives you the error message. Hope this helps. 

Best wishes,
Wei
